jobs.description: Have you ever discovered a product through a creator you follow on social media, then bought it on Amazon? Do you wonder how brands find the right creators to partner with at scale? We are building a new social advertising product that helps brands find customers on social media apps through creators. As the Principal PMT for this new product, you will own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap. You'll define how brands discover high-affinity creators, how campaigns get activated, how creators get compensated, and how the whole system integrates with Amazon's existing advertising products (DSP, Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Creator Ads). You need to be fluent in both worlds: how creators build audiences and monetize content on social platforms, AND how brands evaluate and buy media programmatically. This is a 0-to-1 role. You would be building a new product from the ground up, working backwards from what brands and creators need to define how the product serves both customers and how it goes to market. If you have built creator tools, advertising products, or multi-sided marketplaces, and especially if you have done more than one of those, we want to talk. Key job responsibilities As a Principal Product Manager-Technical for this new product, you will be responsible for building a new product at the intersection of the creator economy and advertising technology. To thrive in this role, you will need to demonstrate: - Bilateral Fluency: You understand both sides of the marketplace: how creators build audiences, create content, and monetize on social platforms (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube) AND how brands evaluate, buy, and measure media programmatically. You can context-switch between a conversation about creator authenticity and one about ROAS measurement without losing either thread. - 0-to-1 Builder Instinct: You are an expert at evaluating whether to take a scrappy approach or spend the time to build a durable solution. Every wrong call here costs precious time. You have a track record of getting this right consistently in ambiguous, early-stage environments where there is no playbook to follow. - Cross-Org Influence: This product delivers most of its value through other teams' systems. You will do significant away-team work in Ads, Associates, and external platform integrations. You earn trust from day one and maintain it through hard conversations where you push partner teams to do things they would not otherwise prioritize. - Data-Grounded Conviction: You use data to form strong opinions, state them clearly, and update them when evidence warrants. You do not hedge conclusions the data supports, and you do not overstate conclusions it does not. - Technical Depth: You can engage meaningfully with scientists on matching algorithms, with engineers on API design, and with ads teams on DSP integration architecture. You do not need to write the code, but you need to understand the tradeoffs well enough to make product decisions that are technically sound. A day in the life You start the morning reviewing creator-brand match quality metrics and slates of individual creators from yesterday's pilot cohort. A brand partner wants to understand why certain creators rank high for their category. You pull the attribution data and walk them through the quantitative signal: which creators are driving conversions for their brand, at what volume, and how that compares to their managed roster. You then shift to qualitative evaluation of the creator's content, audience fit, and brand alignment. Mid-morning, you're in a working session with the science team debating whether to weight recent conversion velocity or lifetime brand affinity more heavily in the matching algorithm. After lunch, you're drafting the integration spec for how campaigns for this new product will surface inside the DSP console, negotiating scope with the Ads PM who owns that surface. By end of day, you're reviewing creator compensation scenarios with the Associates team, making sure the economics work for the brand (willing to pay), the creator (worth their time), and Amazon (sustainable margin). About the team The team is a small group of applied scientists, and engineers. We work across Amazon's creator ecosystem (Associates, Influencer Program, Creator Connections) and ads platform to build something that blends the best parts of both worlds. You would be joining at the stage where there is a solid data hypothesis and brand demand, but the core product decisions are yours to guide.

회사 소개
쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 리테일 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 유지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성(Always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술(High-tech), 초연결사회(Hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.
팀 소개
Trust & Safety Compliance 팀은 쿠팡의 리스크 관리 활동을 모니터링하고, 남용 및 부정을 방지하기 위한 정책과 기준을 수립하는 핵심 역할을 담당합니다. 해당 팀은 상품의 신뢰성, 사용자 안전, 고객 경험에 부정적인 영향을 줄 수 있는 문제를 식별하고 해결합니다.
업무 내용
• 리스크 관리 활동에 대한 감독 및 모니터링
• 비즈니스가 관련 법률, 규정 및 내부 정책을 준수하도록 리스크 관리를 위한 정책, 기준 및 절차 수립과 리스크 평가 수행
• Compliance, Legal, Operations, Product, Engineering을 포함한 파트너 팀들과 협업하여 사기 및 어뷰징 시나리오를 해결
• 규제 환경, 업계 동향, 규범 및 모범 사례, 내부 운영에 대한 최신 정보를 파악하고 이해관계자들에게 솔루션에 기반한 권고사항을 전달
• 비즈니스를 보다 잘 이해하기 위해 노력하여 Compliance가 적절하게 관련 지원을 제공
• 데이터의 이상징후를 검토하여 새로운 및 새롭게 부상하는 위협을 선제적으로 발견
• 데이터 분석을 통해 이슈의 규모를 파악하여 우선순위를 설정하고, 권장 사항을 업데이트
• 내부 표준 준수 및 필요한 개선 사항 발견을 위해 운영 업무를 감사합니다
자격 요건
• 리스크 관리 및/또는 사기예방 분야에서 운영, 컴플라이언스, 감사 또는 컨설팅 관련 10년 이상의 경력을 보유하신 분
• 리스크 통제 프레임워크(예: 비즈니스 리스크 평가, 규제 검토) 경험 및 규제 요건을 해석하여 운영 절차에 반영한 경험이 있으신 분
• 여러 부서 및 이해관계자가 연관되어 있는 문제를 해결한 경험이 있는 뛰어난 문제 해결 능력과 세심한 주의력을 보유하신 분
• 복잡한 리스크 관리 환경 하에서 정책 요구사항을 운영 업무에 반영할 수 있는 능력을 보유하신 분

This is a hands-on, high-visibility role for someone who thrives on solving technical problems, documenting them clearly, and teaching others to do the same. If you love solving complex technical problems, enjoy being hands-on with next-generation vehicles, and want to shape how a brand-new specialty vehicle developed for military use is documented, trained on, and supported in the field, this Field Service Representative role offers a unique opportunity to make a visible impact from development through launch. Applicants must be able to support evening and weekend hours when required. Develop into the go-to Subject Matter Expert for the vehicle's design, function, diagnosis, maintenance, and repair. Maintain awareness of ongoing design changes and engineering updates to keep your technical knowledge and all supporting documentation current. 2. jobs.description: ABOUT THE TEAM OpenAI Consumer Devices is building the next generation of products that bring powerful AI into people’s everyday lives. Our team works across silicon, embedded systems, operating systems, and cloud services to build reliable consumer devices and the novel platforms required to support them. We partner closely with research to bring advanced AI capabilities into the physical world. ABOUT THE ROLE As an Operating Systems Engineer focused on on-device inference, you will design, develop, and ship the OS stack that makes advanced AI capabilities reliable, responsive, and energy efficient on consumer devices. Your work will span OS services and frameworks, inference runtime integration, model fitting, scheduling, and performance and power management. You’ll partner with research to adapt models to device constraints, make design decisions across the stack, and carry solutions from early exploration through integration and production. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: - Build the inference platform: Design and implement maintainable OS services, frameworks, and clear interfaces for inference execution, model loading and lifecycle, and resource management. - Fit models to device constraints: Partner with researchers on quantization, runtime integration, and memory optimization to meet memory, compute, and energy budgets while evaluating model quality and product behavior. - Coordinate system resources: Develop scheduling and resource policies that balance inference with other device activity, preserving responsiveness within latency, memory, battery, and thermal constraints. - Advance performance and power management: Develop and validate execution strategies that adapt to workload needs, available resources, and changing device conditions. - Debug across the stack: Use tracing, profiling, and structured debugging to investigate correctness, concurrency, performance, and reliability issues across models, inference runtimes, and OS components. - Measure and validate improvements: Build diagnostic tools, instrumentation, representative device workloads, and automated tests to demonstrate repeatable performance and energy gains on physical devices, catch regressions, and validate sustained use. - Bring capabilities to production: Collaborate with research, hardware, firmware, platform, and product engineering teams to turn emerging model capabilities into maintainable systems and reliable shipped features. MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS - Substantial hands-on experience designing, developing, and debugging operating system components, system services, or performance-critical platform software. - Proficiency in C++ for systems development, including concurrent programming, memory ownership, and resource lifetime management. - Hands-on experience integrating or optimizing inference runtimes or machine learning workloads in resource-constrained environments. - Strong understanding of scheduling, memory management, and how workloads compete for shared system resources. - Experience diagnosing complex system behavior and delivering performance or power improvements supported by repeatable measurements. - Ability to work across disciplines, translate research and product needs into system requirements, and explain technical decisions and tradeoffs clearly. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU: - Have delivered end-to-end on-device inference in shipped products, from model adaptation and runtime integration through OS support and production debugging. - Have adapted models for deployment through quantization, compression, or related techniques, balancing quality, execution cost, and memory requirements. - Have optimized inference across CPUs, GPUs, or neural accelerators, accounting for data movement, synchronization, and execution placement. - Are proficient in Rust for systems programming. - Take ownership of complete solutions and follow problems across model, runtime, and operating system boundaries. - Challenge assumptions, develop new approaches when existing techniques fall short, and use experiments and measurements to guide decisions. - Work constructively across disciplines and make careful tradeoffs among model quality, performance, power, reliability, security, and maintainability. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.
